soundBank.title: Banco suoni
soundBank.description: Libreria di campioni per la sintesi audio. I banchi leggeri riducono l'uso della memoria.

banks.FluidR3_GM: Banco GM di riferimento. Campioni ricchi e dettagliati per tutti i 128 strumenti. Migliore qualità complessiva ma download più pesante.
banks.GeneralUserGS: Banco GM/GS ad alta fedeltà. Eccellente equilibrio tra qualità e dimensione. Strumenti caldi e dal suono naturale.
banks.JCLive: Banco basato su registrazioni dal vivo. Batteria incisiva, ottoni brillanti. Ottimo per rock, jazz e stili dal vivo.
banks.Aspirin: Banco pulito e bilanciato. Pianoforti morbidi, archi chiari. Buono per classica e pop.
banks.SBLive: Banco Creative Labs Sound Blaster Live. Solido tuttofare con carattere nostalgico.
banks.Chaos: Banco creativo leggero. Caricamento rapido, suoni essenziali ma funzionali per anteprima veloce.
banks.SoundBlasterOld: Banco Sound Blaster classico. Ingombro minimo, carattere retrò. Ideale per connessioni a bassa larghezza di banda.

instrumentSettings.handsMovementHint: Enables the "Hands" tab so you can configure each hand's position and maximum span. Note-to-hand assignment is automatic during playback.

instrumentSettings.keyboardTypeHint: Chromatic: one finger = one note (xylophone, hangdrum…). Piano: the hand covers more semitones than fingers (the blacks between the whites).
instrumentSettings.handsCcPositionHint: CC number used to send the hand position (value = lowest MIDI note in the current hand window).
instrumentSettings.handsSpanSemitonesHint: Maximum interval of notes playable without moving the hand.
instrumentSettings.handsNumFingersHint: Maximum number of keys this hand can press at once (caps the per-hand polyphony).

instrumentSettings.handsAutoAssignmentInfo: Note-to-hand assignment runs automatically based on tracks and the maximum span — the split note and hysteresis are computed at playback time. You can still tweak individual notes from the editor.

instrumentSettings.handsKeyboardMechAlignedDesc: One actuator per key inside the hand window. The hand slides as a block; the span configured below sets how many keys it covers.
instrumentSettings.handsKeyboardMech5FingersDesc: Humanoid hand with 5 independently-actuated fingers (arbitrary chords, non-adjacent fingers). Reserved for the V2 of the project.
instrumentSettings.discardChangesMessage: You have unsaved changes. Discard and close?
instrumentSettings.toggleNotationHelp: Toggle between US notation (C, D, E…) and Latin notation (Do, Ré, Mi…)
instrumentSettings.handsStringMechanismHint: Pick first — drives the fret-selection logic and the parameters shown below.
instrumentSettings.handsStringMechStringSlidingDesc: Each finger is anchored to a string and slides along it across the hand's width (multiple frets reachable per finger).
instrumentSettings.handsStringMechFretSlidingDesc: Each finger is fixed at a fret offset within the hand and crosses the strings to choose which one to press. Optional “variable-height fingers” for 2 or 3 fingers.
instrumentSettings.handsStringMechIndependentDesc: 4 fingers with 2 axes each (string × fret). Supports barré, arbitrary chords, human-like playing. Reserved for the V2 of the project.
instrumentSettings.handsGeometryHint: Pick a preset close to your instrument to pre-fill the geometry. Every field stays editable.
instrumentSettings.handsFretsCcPositionHint: CC emitted. Value = lowest absolute fret (capo included).
instrumentSettings.handsHandSpanMmHint: Total physical span covered by the hand.
instrumentSettings.handsMoveSpeedMmHint: Mechanical travel speed along the neck.
instrumentSettings.handsMaxFingersHint: Maximum number of strings pressed simultaneously. Defaults to the number of strings.
instrumentSettings.handsFretSlidingNumFingersHint: Each finger sits at a fixed fret offset and slides between strings.
instrumentSettings.handsVariableHeightFingersHint: Of the fingers above, how many have an adjustable fret offset (0 = all fixed).
instrumentSettings.handsFretsEnableHint: When enabled, the player emits a CC with the lowest absolute fret of the window every time the hand needs to move.
instrumentSettings.handsFretsNoScaleWarning: No scale length set. Pick a preset below or enter the length manually to enable the physical (mm) model.
instrumentSettings.harmonicaTypeHelp: Diatonic: Richter tuning. Chromatic: solo tuning plus a slide button that raises every note by one semitone.
instrumentSettings.harmonicaKeyHelp: Harmonica key: transposes the hole layout. The number of holes follows the instrument's configured note range.
instrumentSettings.accordionBassHelp: Left-side play possibilities (both sides are always present).
instrumentSettings.accordionBassRangeHelp: Min/max playable MIDI note on the left side (free-bass only).
instrumentSettings.accordionStradellaHelp: Number of columns (circle-of-fifths steps), reference fundamental note, and which function rows are present (Stradella only).

instrumentSettings.bagpipePresetHelp: Choosing a preset fills the drones below.
instrumentSettings.bagpipeDronesHelp: Click a key (its MIDI number is shown) to add/remove a drone. Each drone can be enabled individually.
